mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession fears.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 5.0%, the market anticipates a tightening cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: During the housing market downturn (as indicated by housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102.0 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1330.0, the economy is in a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 102.0 and HOUST < 1330.0.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and low interest rate regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS < 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.
